Unmortgaging Park Place would cost about $193, leaving me only $29 and no funds for houses, though it would complete my dark blue monopoly and double rents to 100 and 70. That's risky given opponents already have hotels on Oriental, Vermont, and Connecticut.

With only $29 left, I'd be forced to mortgage something to cover rent anyway, and mortgaging only returns half value, so holding onto cash for liquidity seems smarter than paying the 10% fee now. Trading Indiana to p4 is too dangerous since they already hold Kentucky and that would hand them the red monopoly, so I'll just end my turn.
